message.content:
(1) **What is visible:** The ProjectGallery section displays a dark-themed layout with a "PROJECT GALLERY" heading, a large descriptive title, and the top row of two gradient cards (one orange-to-dark, one orange-to-grey) with icons, partially obscured by a floating navigation bar and a contact widget.

(2) **Visual Quality:** **6/10** – The typography and color palette are professional, but the composition is severely cluttered by overlapping UI elements.

(3) **Top Improvements:** 
- **Z-index/Spacing Conflict:** The "On this page" navigation bar and contact widget overlap and obscure the gallery cards, making them difficult to read; these should be repositioned or the section given more vertical padding.
- **Incomplete Gallery View:** Only 2 of the 6 expected cards are visible, and the bottom row is cut off; ensure all 6 cards are fully rendered within the viewport or scrollable area.

(4) **Production-Ready:** **No** – The overlapping elements create poor UX and the incomplete card grid fails to meet the requirement of showing 6 items.
